concerns.text: Plan.md Phase 1 Task 1.1 requires generating a 'data_gap_report.md' and halting if BMRQ is missing. Task T011 mentions verifying column existence but lacks an explicit task to generate the report and halt the pipeline, leaving the 'Data Gap Report' requirement from the plan unimplemented.

Spec.md SC-005 requires measuring sample size (N) against power requirements and reporting the result. Task T025 performs the power analysis and outputs a gate status, but no task exists to explicitly report the final achieved power or effect size as a verification artifact for SC-005.

Spec.md SC-002 requires measuring explained variance (R²) against a 'null model (intercept only)' baseline. Task T027 implements Ridge/Lasso regression but lacks a specific task to fit and report the null model baseline required for the comparison defined in SC-002.

Spec.md FR-004 and US-2 require calculating and utilizing 'edge-level connectivity strengths'. Task T020 saves these to a JSON file, but Task T021 (merge) only mentions merging 'connectivity features' generally. There is no explicit task confirming edge-level features are included in the final analysis dataset for hypothesis testing.

Task T029 implements 'bootstrap stability analysis'. While the Plan mentions this as an off-CI activity, the Spec.md (FR-005) only mandates partial correlation and regularized regression. T029 appears to be scope creep (a task for a requirement not in the spec) unless it is strictly considered part of the 'statistical rigor' implied by US-3, but it lacks a direct [FR-NNN] or [SC-NNN] tag linking it to a specific spec requirement.
